review_evidence: The source contains the divided-power algebra, divided-power structures, graded constructions, tensor products, topology, homogeneous algebra, and substantial ForMathlib material.
DividedPowers/Test.lean and PolynomialLaw/Test.lean contain actual lemmas/examples, including three combinatorial theorems in Test.lean; test naming is therefore not an exclusion signal.

The Oneshot tree contains hundreds of definitions/theorems across divided powers, infinite sums, power series, graded algebra, and tensor products. Oneshot/Main.lean is import-only navigation into retained modules and is kept rather than hard-excluded.
summary: Reviewed the complete DividedPowers4 repository; current and Oneshot divided-power developments, tests, and navigation files remain searchable with no additional hard exclusion.

review_evidence: DividedPowers/DPAlgebra/Dpow.lean: 84 declaration-keyword lines, including onDPAlgebra_unique, noncomputable def cK, noncomputable def dpow, dpow_eq, dpow_embed, dpow_mem, lift_dpow, lift_dpow_of_lift_eq_zero; the divided-power structure on the divided power algebra.

DividedPowers/ForMathlib/LinearAlgebra/Isomorphisms.lean (read in full): live noncomputable def LinearMap.equivOfSurjective, a bijection between maps N ->l[R] P and maps g : M ->l[R] P with ker f <= ker g, with its proof, plus simp theorem equivOfSurjective_symm_apply.

DividedPowers/ForMathlib/Data/FinsetLemmas.lean (read in full): imports, section, namespace Finset, open Sym, and end Finset are live; the lemmas sym_map (full tactic proof), prod_smul' and Sym.sum_eq_val_sum are in comments. summary: Read FinsetLemmas.lean and Isomorphisms.lean completely and grepped plus sampled Dpow.lean. Dpow.lean and Isomorphisms.lean carry live Lean declarations with proofs. FinsetLemmas.lean has no live declaration, but its commented blocks hold full Lean statements and proofs (Finset.sym_map with a complete tactic proof, prod_smul', Sym.sum_eq_val_sum) that are searchable formal text, so no content-level evidence shows that nothing unique is lost.
